summary: St. Joe NF patrol site on Nakarna Mountain, patrol point for the Carpenter Mountain lookout (abandoned 1942); no record of a structure on the peak itself.

events.note: Carpenter Mountain lookout, which listed a patrol point atop Nakarna Mountain, was abandoned in 1942

evidence.supports: Listed as a patrol lookout in the St. Joe National Forest, at 43N-1W-20
Agency is the St. Joe National Forest
Benewah County index lists Nakarna Mountain as a patrol lookout (PTRL LO)
Carpenter Mountain lookout: camp in 1937, 20-foot pole platform in 1938
evidence.quote: 1937: camp, 8' log crib with alidade. 1938: 20' pole platform.

evidence.supports: Patrol point one mile west, atop Nakarna Mountain
evidence.quote: Patrol point 1 mile west atop Nakarna Mtn.

evidence.supports: Carpenter Mountain lookout is five miles southwest of Fernwood
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the same patrol point atop Nakarna Mountain
evidence.quote: Patrol Point: 1 Mile west atop Nakarna Mtn.

evidence.supports: Idaho Fire Lookouts dates the camp to 1939
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1942 as the abandonment year
Carpenter Mountain site is hike-in and abandoned

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com dates the camp to 1937 and the pole platform to 1938; Idaho Fire Lookouts dates the camp to 1939. The story reports both dates and the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build date, staffing or fate for anything on Nakarna itself; the dates belong to the Carpenter Mountain lookout, which is a separate record. Brief status and kind (unknown) are unchanged; the Benewah index and Forest Lookouts both call the site a patrol lookout, so kind could be point or unknown in the editor's call. The Benewah index places Carpenter (43N-1W-21) in the section next to Nakarna (43N-1W-20), which fits a nearby patrol point. Two WebSearch calls used. The Forest Lookouts page itself is only the header lines, so the Benewah index carries the county and PLSS.
